title: Tree props
description: A Tree item's props (FR-11, design decision 2): its columns and its nodes. A node holds its ID, its name, its children and a value for any field a column declares: a string for a text column, a number for a number column, absent when empty. What a schema cannot say (IDs unique across levels, the view's prefix, each field declared by a column and of its type, column fields unique, the node count and depth limits) is checked by treePropsProblems. In no schema set until the input format reaches 1.1.

column.description: A field every node may hold, addressed as item.node.field (AD-13): never id, label or children, never a spreadsheet cell.

node.description: A node: its ID (unique in the item, at every level), its name, its children if it has any, and its fields.

value.description: A field's value: text of 1 to 1,000 characters or a number, by its column's type.
